provenance: Public third-party extraction of VALORANT client map data. This endpoint is not operated by Riot Games; English labels are copied verbatim from its en-US game records, not independently presented as a Riot API. Local Chinese labels and transformed map coordinates match the corresponding zh-CN records.
labelComposition: superRegionName + " " + regionName; both copied verbatim from en-US records

riotPrimaryCrossChecks.supports: Official English map names Ascent, Split, Haven, Summit, Lotus, Abyss; local/API asset paths establish map identity.
Split official callouts A Main, A Ramps, B Tower, B Main, Mid Top.
Haven official callouts C Link, A Link, C Long, A Sewer; Ascent A Main and spawn/Garden areas.
Ascent official map description identifies the boathouse and Courtyard, Garden, Market callouts. Exact B Boat House spelling comes from client record extraction.
